title: OutArcaneTrap
description: ✨ OutArcaneTrap — Schematics, Traps, Walls. Block restoration, sounds, effects, and more!
body:
# ✨ OutArcaneTrap — Ultimate Custom Wall & Trap System for Minecraft

The most advanced custom items plugin for Minecraft Paper 1.21+. Place .schem structures with a right-click, build 5x5 walls instantly, and create amazing gameplay mechanics with full protection and restoration!



--- ## 🏗️ About OutArcaneTrap **OutMagicItems** is a powerful and flexible plugin that allows you to create **magical items** that place custom structures from .schem files or build 5x5 walls instantly. Perfect for traps, arenas, custom gameplay mechanics, or just adding some magic to your server! Unlike other schematic plugins, OutMagicItems **saves every original block** before placing a structure and **perfectly restores them** when the structure expires — including container contents like chests, barrels, and shulkers! No more broken builds or lost items. --- ## ✨ Feature Showcase
🏗️ Schematic System
| Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **.schem Support** | Place any WorldEdit schematic with a right-click | | **Block Restoration** | Every original block is saved and perfectly restored | | **Container Saving** | Chests, barrels, shulkers contents are saved and restored | | **Protection Zone** | Configurable radius around structures where building/breaking is blocked | | **Intersection Prevention** | Structures cannot overlap with each other | | **Multiple Placement Modes** | `feet`, `target`, `absolute`, `relative` placement options | | **Offset Controls** | Fine-tune X, Y, Z offsets for perfect positioning |
🧱 Wall System (5x5 "Plast")
| Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **6 Direction Support** | Walls place correctly when looking: North, South, East, West, Up, Down | | **Random Block Mixing** | Create walls with random block percentages (40% stone, 30% cobble, etc.) | | **Custom Materials** | Define exactly which blocks appear in your walls | | **Perfect Orientation** | Walls always place perpendicular to your view | | **Protection Zone** | 2-block radius protection around walls (configurable) |
⚡ Trap Effects
| Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Potion Effects** | Apply effects to enemies in radius: FIRE, POISON, SLOW, WEAKNESS, WITHER, BLINDNESS, HUNGER | | **Effect Radius** | Configurable radius for each trap | | **Owner Bypass** | Option to not apply effects to the player who placed the trap | | **Check Interval** | Configurable how often effects are applied |
🔊 Audio & Visual
| Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Place Sounds** | Custom sounds when placing structures/walls | | **Remove Sounds** | Custom sounds when structures expire | | **Small Caps Support** | Beautiful small caps text formatting with colors | | **Custom Item Names** | Full color & formatting support with & codes |
🔒 Protection System
| Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Structure Protection** | Players cannot break blocks that are part of active structures | | **Perimeter Protection** | Configurable radius around structures where building/breaking is blocked | | **Intersection Prevention** | Structures cannot be placed overlapping existing ones | | **Player Quit Cleanup** | All player structures are removed when they leave |
--- ## 📋 Requirements | Requirement | Version | Reason | |-------------|---------|--------| | **Paper** | 1.21+ | Core server software | | **WorldEdit** | 7.4.0+ | Required for .schem file support | | **Java** | 21+ | Required for Paper 1.21 | > **⚠️ IMPORTANT:** WorldEdit is **REQUIRED** for this plugin to work! The plugin will not enable without WorldEdit installed. --- ## 📥 Installation Guide | Step | Action | |------|--------| | 1️⃣ | **Install WorldEdit** — Download and install WorldEdit 7.4.0+ first | | 2️⃣ | **Download** — Get the latest `.jar` from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/outmagicitems) | | 3️⃣ | **Install** — Place the JAR into your server's `plugins/` folder | | 4️⃣ | **Restart** — Restart your server (DO NOT use `/reload`) | | 5️⃣ | **Configure** — Edit configuration files in `plugins/OutMagicItems/` | | 6️⃣ | **Add Schematics** — Place your .schem files in `plugins/OutMagicItems/schems/` | | 7️⃣ | **Enjoy!** — Give items with `/omi give [amount]` | --- ## 🎮 Commands & Permissions ### 👤 Player Commands | Command | Description | Permission | Default | |---------|-------------|------------|---------| | `/omi list` | List all available items and walls | `outmagicitems.use` | ✅ All players | | `/outmagicitems` | Alias for main command | `outmagicitems.use` | ✅ All players | | `/omi` | Alias for main command | `outmagicitems.use` | ✅ All players | ### 👑 Admin Commands | Command | Description | Permission | Default | |---------|-------------|------------|---------| | `/omi give [amount]` | Give item to player | `outmagicitems.admin` | ❌ Ops only | | `/omi reload` | Reload all configurations | `outmagicitems.admin` | ❌ Ops only | | `/omi debug` | Show active structures info | `outmagicitems.admin` | ❌ Ops only | ### 🔑 Permissions | Permission | Description | Default | |------------|-------------|---------| | `outmagicitems.use` | Use basic plugin commands and items | ✅ All players | | `outmagicitems.admin` | Admin commands (give, reload, debug) | ❌ Ops only | --- ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Do I need WorldEdit? YES! WorldEdit 7.4.0+ is REQUIRED for .schem file support. The plugin will not enable without WorldEdit installed.
Where do I put my .schem files? Place them in plugins/OutMagicItems/schems/. The plugin will automatically create this folder on first start.
Does it save container contents? YES! All chests, barrels, shulkers, and any inventory holder contents are saved and perfectly restored when the structure expires.
Can players build inside structures? No! The protection system prevents block breaking/placing within the structure and in the configurable radius around it.
What happens if two structures overlap? The plugin prevents overlapping structures. You cannot place a new structure that intersects with an existing one.
Do walls work when looking up/down? YES! When you look straight up or down, the wall places horizontally as a floor or ceiling.
Can I use random blocks in walls? YES! You can configure percentages for different blocks in the walls.yml file.
